title: Tangential divergence of the rotation field g·A of a plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P, a, e, x ∈ ℝ^P, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be differentiable at x. Put A y := ⟨y,a⟩e − ⟨y,e⟩a and X(y) := g(y)·A y. Let T := approxTangentPlane n M x and let p := T.starProjection be the orthogonal projection onto T. Then tangentialDivergence n M X x = trace(p ∘ DX(x)) equals Dg(x)(p(A x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (a e x : Euclid P) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → tangentialDivergence n M (fun y : Euclid P => g y • (inner ℝ y a • e - inner ℝ y e • a)) x = fderiv ℝ g x ((approxTangentPlane n M x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a))
